title: Proposals
caption: The house proposes — you decide. Everything the house would like to change is here: new rules and ML block authority. Nothing turns on without your approval.

actions.scanNowHint: Run all three scanners immediately: the event-log scanner, pattern discovery and the ML-task scanner. They also run on their own schedule.
actions.simulateHint: Replay the rule over the last 7 days of history and see how often it would have fired. Nothing is actually executed.

rejectTooltip: Dismiss the card. Nothing in the house changes.

help.what: Each card is one concrete change. "Approve" applies it immediately (the card says exactly what will happen), "Reject" just dismisses the card without changing anything. An approved decision keeps an id so the action stays traceable.

sources.ml_proposer: Event-log scanner — spots simple pairs "sensor fired → you turned a device on yourself" that repeat day after day.
sources.discovery: Pattern discovery — a statistical search for richer regularities (thresholds, time of day) with false-discovery control. It also spots multi-device states you keep arranging by hand and proposes saving them as scenes.
sources.ml_task_scanner: ML-task scanner — notices quantities with enough accumulated history and suggests starting to train a model.
sources.user: You — e.g. an ML block promotion requested from the Blocks page.

help.schedule: The scanners run on their own schedule (every few hours). "Check now" runs all three immediately.
help.review: Before approving a rule, press "Simulate" — the rule is replayed over 7 days of history so you can see when it would have fired. Approve once the result matches your expectation.

sourceHint.ml_proposer: Found by the event-log scanner: a simple "sensor → your action" pair
sourceHint.discovery: Found by the statistical pattern search over history
sourceHint.ml_task_scanner: Suggested by the ML-task scanner: enough history to train
sourceHint.intervention: Noticed you keep overriding this rule
sourceHint.demo: A test proposal from the demo script — safe to reject

effect.rule: the rule becomes active and starts running on its own.
effect.pin: the block is pinned to model version v{{version}} and stops switching to newer ones.
effect.unpin: the block will follow the latest model version.
effect.mlTask: a "{{target}}" training task appears — tune it on the ML page.
effect.scene: a scene "{{name}}" is created from {{count}} devices — find and edit it on the Scenes page.
effect.sceneSchedule: a scene "{{name}}" is created from {{count}} devices and activated automatically every day at {{time}}.
effect.amendmentDisable: the rule is disabled (re-enable it any time on the Automations page).
effect.amendmentAddCondition: a time-of-day exception is added — the rule runs only outside {{from}}–{{to}} (edit it any time on the Automations page).
effect.amendmentSetThreshold: the trigger threshold is changed to {{value}} (edit it any time on the Automations page).

evidence.coocc: Over the last {{windowDays}} days this happened {{support}} times: in {{confidence}}% of cases the trigger was followed by this action.
evidence.stats: That is {{lift}}× the base rate (significance p = {{p}}).
evidence.setpoint: You set ≈{{value}} at this time {{support}} times (spread ±{{stdDev}}).
evidence.mlSetpoint: You changed this setpoint often ({{samples}} times, spread ±{{stdDev}}), and {{explained}}% of those changes track the time of day — too varied for one schedule, but a model can learn it.
evidence.mlTask: {{samples}} records accumulated over {{windowDays}} days (≥ {{required}} needed) — enough history, and a block exists that can consume the model.
evidence.scene: You arranged this set of {{devices}} devices by hand {{support}} times over the last {{windowDays}} days.
evidence.deadRule: You overrode this rule in {{overrides}} of its {{firings}} runs ({{rate}}%) — it may no longer match how you use the home.
evidence.refine: You overrode this rule in {{overrides}} of its {{firings}} runs ({{rate}}%) between {{from}}–{{to}} — but it looks fine the rest of the day.
evidence.thresholdDrift: When you overrode the rule, the sensor read about {{suggested}}, not its trigger value {{current}} ({{samples}} times) — the threshold may have drifted (season/habit).

scanResult: Done. Event-log scanner: +{{suggested}}, pattern discovery: +{{discovered}}, ML tasks: +{{tasks}}.
scanNothing: Checked everything — no new proposals. Everything found was either proposed before, or the history has too few repeated actions yet.
scanPartial: Some scanners did not respond ({{failed}}). The rest produced: +{{created}}.
simResult_one: Would have fired {{count}}× over 7 days ({{events}} events scanned)
simResult_other: Would have fired {{count}}× over 7 days ({{events}} events scanned)

empty.pending: Nothing is waiting for your decision. Press "Check now" to look for proposals — or come back later: the scanners run on their own schedule.
empty.all: No proposals yet. The house starts proposing once repeated actions accumulate in the event log.

errors.load: Failed to load proposals. Check ApiGateway / DbGateway connection.
errors.scan: Failed to run the scanners — is the AutomationService reachable?
errors.approve: Approve failed — the target may no longer exist, or a service is unreachable.
errors.reject: Reject failed — is the gateway reachable?
errors.simulate: Simulate failed — is the AutomationService reachable?
